notify_waiting.label: Notify when a session needs you
notify_waiting.description: Desktop notification when a session starts waiting for a permission or an answer.

notify_finished.label: Notify when a session finishes
notify_finished.description: Desktop notification when a session goes from working to idle.

finished_min_minutes.label: Minimum turn length (minutes)
finished_min_minutes.description: Only notify about turns that took at least this long.

show_elsewhere.label: Show Remote Control sessions on other machines
show_elsewhere.description: Lists your live Remote Control sessions running elsewhere, checked once a minute through Claude Code's internal session list.

hide_idle_hours.label: Hide sessions idle for (hours)
hide_idle_hours.description: Hide live sessions idle longer than this. 0 shows all.

recent_count.label: Recent sessions
recent_count.description: Closed sessions offered for resume in the panel and the launcher. 0 turns Recent off.

limits_refresh_minutes.label: Plan limits refresh (minutes)
limits_refresh_minutes.description: Minutes between plan-limit and usage refreshes.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Currency for cost estimates. Non-USD amounts use daily exchange rates.

currency_api_url.label: Exchange-rate API
currency_api_url.description: Frankfurter-compatible endpoint the daily exchange rates come from.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.description: Terminal for new and resumed sessions. Empty opens a kitty tab when kitty remote control is on, else Noctalia's terminal.

editor_command.label: Editor command
editor_command.description: Command that opens a CLAUDE.md. Empty tries code, then zed.

work_root.label: Projects folder
work_root.description: Project paths under this folder are shown relative to it. Empty shows full paths.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Bar widget glyph. It turns into a red bell while a session needs you.

bar_style.label: Bar style
bar_style.description: How the bar shows running sessions.

bar_limits.label: Bar limits
bar_limits.description: Plan usage windows shown on the bar.

bar_limits_style.label: Bar limits style
bar_limits_style.description: How each window is drawn on the bar.

options.gauge: Nested gauge (5h inside 7d, faint arc = projection)

notify_limits.label: Warn before a limit
notify_limits.description: Notify once per window when the current rate reaches the 5-hour limit within the hour, or a weekly limit within a day.
